Chrissy — 14:00 PT on Tue 11/30 is locked on our side. Ive put together a starter kickoff runbook (attached) and a short prework checklist. Quick lineup from our side:

- Aditya Rao — Account lead / introductions
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (post-kickoff plan & SLA ops)
- Dev Patel — Implementation lead (workspace, model config, first-run)
- Ben Carter — Onboarding engineer (integration & demos)
- Lauren Bishop — Product (timeboxed Q&A on product roadmap & APIs)

Proposed 75-min agenda (we can tighten to 60 if you prefer):
1) 0–10m — Intros & success criteria
2) 10–30m — Architecture & data handoff (Ben + Leila)
3) 30–50m — Workspace access & sample run (Dev)
4) 50–60m — Security notes & SSO/SCIM (Lauren + security lead)
5) 60–75m — Next steps, owners, and timelines (Marissa)

Prework wed like from Acme before the call:
- Add onboarding@acme-analytics.com to your test workspace (well provide the invite link after confirm)
- Upload a small sample (1–5 JSONL records) or provide schema (Data Eng)
- Confirm security contact for SSO items

Attachments: kickoff-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook), onboarding-prework-checklist.md
Meeting link (provisional): https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcd-123
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-0457

We will record and circulate action items right after the call. If that agenda looks good Ill send the calendar invite and a shorter runbook (one-pager) for attendees.

Thanks — Dev
